biotools.summary: The MRS4Brain Toolbox is an open-source, MATLAB-based platform for analyzing preclinical MR spectroscopic imaging data (proton and deuterium). It provides integrated workflows for preprocessing, quantification, and metabolic map analysis using a GUI.
